parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID

parameters.name: link_name

parameters.help_en: The data source type. Valid values: OSS, DINGTALK, FEISHU, and SHAREPOINT
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，支持 OSS、DINGTALK、FEISHU、SHAREPOINT
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source tenant. This parameter is required and must be set to the Entra tenant ID when SourceType is set to SHAREPOINT, the tenant_key when SourceType is set to FEISHU, or the corpId when SourceType is set to DINGTALK. This parameter is not required when SourceType is set to OSS
parameters.help_zh: 来源租户 ID。SourceType=SHAREPOINT 时必填 Entra tenant ID；FEISHU 时必填 tenant_key；DINGTALK 时必填 corpId；OSS 时无需填写
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DingTalk operator
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉操作用户 ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of a successful snapshot of Feishu chat members for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter can be explicitly set only for FEISHU synchronization links. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 indicates that snapshot fallback reuse is disabled. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of a snapshot allowed for reuse. Default value: -1. If this parameter is omitted, the default value -1 takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路可显式设置；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；默认值为 -1，省略时按 -1 生效
parameters.name: feishu_chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en: The TTL of a successful snapshot of chat members for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter applies to DINGTALK and FEISHU synchronization links. If this parameter is explicitly configured, it takes precedence. If it is not configured, Feishu uses the value of FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 indicates that snapshot fallback reuse is disabled. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of a successful snapshot in the same workspace, enterprise, and chat group allowed for reuse. If this parameter is omitted, Feishu uses the legacy dedicated field. If neither is configured, the default value is -1
parameters.help_zh: 群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。适用于 DINGTALK、FEISHU 同步链路；显式配置本字段时优先使用本字段，未配置时飞书沿用 FeishuChatMemberStaleTtlSeconds；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的同空间、同企业、同群成功快照的最大年龄；省略时飞书沿用旧专用字段，均未配置时默认 -1
parameters.name: chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization scope mode. This parameter applies only to DINGTALK sources and must be set together with SelectionRules. Valid values:
ALL: Synchronizes files in the source directory that are not excluded by excludes. The includes array must be empty.
SELECTED: Synchronizes only files that match includes and are not excluded by excludes. If includes is empty, no files are selected.
New configurations take effect starting from the next synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于钉钉来源（DINGTALK），须与 SelectionRules 同时设置。ALL：同步来源目录内未被 excludes 排除的文件，includes 必须为空数组。SELECTED：仅同步 includes 匹配且未被 excludes 排除的文件；includes 为空时不选择任何文件。新配置从下次同步开始生效
parameters.name: selection_mode

parameters.help_en: The file path filtering rules in JSON format. This parameter contains only two required string arrays: includes and excludes. Paths are relative to SourceDir, and exclusion rules take precedence. GLOB is supported: * and ? do not cross directories, and ** matches zero or more directory levels when it occupies a path segment alone. The two arrays can contain a maximum of 256 entries in total. Each entry must be 1 to 512 characters in length. The maximum size of the JSON text is 65,536 UTF-8 bytes. After a file is removed from the synchronization scope, the corresponding document imported by this synchronization link is cleaned up, without affecting the source file or documents of other synchronization links
parameters.help_zh: JSON 格式的文件路径筛选规则，仅包含 includes、excludes 两个必填的字符串数组。路径相对 SourceDir，排除规则优先。支持 GLOB：* 和 ? 不跨目录，** 独占路径段时匹配零到多级目录。两数组合计最多 256 条，每条长度为 1～512 个字符，JSON 文本最大为 65536 个 UTF-8 字节。移出同步范围后，将清理本同步链路已导入的对应文档，不影响源文件和其他同步链路的文档
parameters.name: selection_rules

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable synchronization for source deletions
parameters.help_zh: 源端删除同步开关
parameters.name: source_delete_sync_enabled
